CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactSecurityPortfolio_PBIen_View]
	AS 

WITH FactSecurityPortfolio_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio_PBIen as FDL
)

Select SEC.*
from DW.FactSecurityPortfolio_PBIen as SEC
    INNER JOIN FactSecurityPortfolio_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = SEC.BusinessDateSK
